mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, identity_type, identity_value, verified_at, created_at FROM user_identity WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND identity_type IN ('MOBILE', 'EMAIL') ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_identity (id, user_id, identity_type, identity_value, verified_at, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{identityType}, #{identityValue}, #{verifiedAt}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM user_identity WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND verified_at IS NOT NULL AND identity_type IN ('MOBILE', 'EMAIL')
